name: The Grillmaster
description: Controls fire, meat, and conversations nobody asked for. Sweating over a grill burns water fast.

name: The DIY Dad
description: Weaponized confidence. Best at combining junk into worse junk. Steady metabolism, steady work.

name: The Tech Dad
dadism_1: Turn It Off and On Again
description: Forgets to eat. Forgets to drink. Has survived on forgotten granola bars and spite since 2014.

name: The Gym Dad
description: Needs protein every 90 seconds. Already dehydrated. Has been since 2009.

name: The Tactical Dad
description: Has packed snacks. Did not pack enough water. The plan did not account for this.

name: The Sports Dad
description: Coaches from the sideline at a volume the league has formally discussed. Reads the field, misreads the room. Tailgate logistics: flawless.

name: The Yard Dad
description: At war with the lawn, the weeds, and the neighbor's slightly greener grass. Diagonal stripes are not a choice. They are a calling.
